resources.string: "With the band on, the line of the precipitation probability is the share of the ensemble members that give at least 0.1 mm of precipitation in the hour. The band below it reaches down to the share of the members with at least 1 mm. These are neither percentiles nor a median."
"Probability: the share of the ensemble members with at least 0.1 mm in the hour; the band reaches down to the share with at least 1 mm."
